_doc: Active generated fragments for merge-city-plan.py --include-pockets. Pockets overlapping a d*-compiled replacement district are excluded (see EXTERIOR-PLACEMENT-BRAIN-PLAN.md W6/W7). d99 measures catalog coverage and must NOT be merged into the played plan.
_block_fill_doc: d29/d30/d31 fill the emptiest three of the 21 core street-grid blocks (r1c4 12%, r2c3 25%, r3c3 27% sprite coverage measured in the real renderer). Specs live in data/city-specs/biome-specs/blocks/. They are pockets, not district replacements, so they carry no d{N}-compiled.json name and merge whole.

exclude_reason.d99-catalog-showcase.json: COVERAGE METRICS ONLY, NOT CITY DESIGN. compile-coverage-showcase.py parks every orphan me.* in empty world space to lift Tier A/B numbers; merging it put 683 exhibit stamps, 23 bare paving patches and 23 'CATALOG SHOWCASE - <BIOME>' labels into the played city across 13 zones, so players walked past buildings lined up in rows on blank concrete. Keep running the compiler to measure coverage; strip its output with scripts/strip-showcase-from-plan.py after any merge that reintroduces showcase-tagged elements.
